findings.reason: Elite Droid is declared by packs/classes.db, data/talent_tree_class_map.json, data/talent-tree-descriptions.json and scripts/mentor/mentor-survey/prestige-survey-profiles.js. Only the compendium document was absent, so the class reference was restored rather than deleted. Its talent documents are genuinely missing and are recorded as a content gap.

data/talent_tree_class_map.json and data/talent-tree-descriptions.json both spell this tree "Master of Teräs Käsi". Both classes already reference the tree by id in talentTreeSourceIds, so no membership changed — only the de-accented compendium name was corrected so the slug resolves.

Same tree (Jedi Guardian) as the canonical 816ac9cc1e6c413b, which the Jedi Guardian tree actually claims. Its prerequisites field ("Prerequisites: Dual Weapon Mastery I, ...") and its benefit text belong to other talents entirely. No tree, class, actor, registry or data file references this id — only two dated audit snapshots under docs/, which are records of the previous state and were left as-is.

data/fixes/talents.fixed.json gives this document talent_tree "Provocateur", class Noble and prerequisite "Distress to Discord" — matching the prerequisitesStructured already on the pack document. e19c06b6dfc7a703 is the Outlaw talent of the same name. They are two different talents in two different trees, not a duplicate, so both are retained and this one was moved to the tree its authority names.

Neither was deleted. The audit's duplicate-name rule was keyed on the name alone, which cannot distinguish this from a real in-tree collision, so the rule was rescoped to tree + name.

Keyed on the name alone, duplicateTalentNames flagged nine canonical cross-tree name reuses whose only possible "fix" was deleting correct documents. Keyed on tree + name it still fails on two same-name documents inside one tree, which is the defect the rule exists to catch: run against the pre-repair packs it reports exactly the corrupt Force Meld copy and the mis-filed Provocateur "Seize the Moment", and zero against the repaired packs. tests/talent-membership-and-pack-completion.test.mjs pins that behaviour with a synthetic same-tree fixture.
